# Zudo Works

> Zudo Works is a software company that builds Zoho Creator applications, implements and customizes Zoho CRM, writes Deluge scripts and API integrations, and develops custom business software. We work remotely with businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand and India.

## Company facts
- Identity: Zudo Works is not affiliated with any similarly named company or brand, including Zodoworks and ZedWorks, in India or anywhere else. zudoworks.com is the official and only website of Zudo Works.
- Name: Zudo Works
- Legal entity: SVP Software and Global Solutions Corporation (private limited company registered in India, CIN U62011TN2026PTC197823)
- Registered office: Flat no.2, Plot no.1051, I-Block, 35th Street, 18th Main Road, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600040, India
- Email: admin@zudoworks.com
- WhatsApp: +91 63854 35382 (https://wa.me/916385435382); voice calls for India-based enquiries on the same number
- Website: https://zudoworks.com/
- Experience: team members have worked on 20+ projects for 10+ client businesses, much of it as developers at a previous organization; hands-on experience across 15+ core Zoho applications and 25+ other Zoho products
- Pricing: US$15 per hour; fixed-price projects quoted from estimated days and complexity (calculator at https://zudoworks.com/pricing/)
- After-launch offer: every development project includes one month of free support and onboarding after launch
- Zoho partner status: application in progress (Zudo Works is not yet an approved Zoho Partner)

## People
- Arunkumar V, Chief Technology Officer. Received the "Master of Creator (Global Winner)" award from Zoho Creator for outstanding performance in the Zoho Creator Partner Hackathon 2025. As a developer at a previous organization he worked on projects including a point-of-sale system integrated with Zoho One (Trakas Smokers Shop, USA), a student management system (Avalon Care Training, UK), healthcare injury-mapping widgets (USA), executive SQL dashboards (Master Manufacturing, China), a travel pricing engine (Green Mind Travel, Thailand), legal case automation on ManageEngine (SIMAH Legal Management, Saudi Arabia) and a loan-management platform (A Square Loans, India). LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arunkumar-v-5509aa1aa/ . Introduction video: https://youtube.com/shorts/0yaz3NYp3J8 . Author of the Zudo Works Insights articles.

## Services
- Zoho Creator development: custom applications, data models, portals, dashboards and Deluge workflows.
- Zoho CRM implementation and customization: custom modules, blueprints, automation, data migration and training.
- Deluge development: functions, scheduled jobs, custom buttons and API calls across Zoho CRM, Creator and Books.
- Zoho integrations: Zoho REST APIs, webhooks, Zoho Flow and custom middleware connecting Zoho to accounting, e-commerce, payment and in-house systems.
- Zoho Books, Inventory, Desk, Analytics, Projects, People and Zoho One implementation.
- Custom software development: web applications, internal tools and dashboards when Zoho alone isn't the right fit.
- Business process automation and ongoing support and maintenance retainers.

## How we work
1. Discovery call to understand the process, systems and goals.
2. Solution design: data model, automations, integrations and user roles.
3. Build and integration, with testing and data-migration trial runs.
4. Go-live, training for administrators and end users, and documentation.
5. One month of free support and onboarding after launch, then an optional monthly support retainer.

Typical timelines: most focused Zoho CRM or Zoho Creator projects take 2 to 8 weeks; multi-app rollouts with several integrations usually take 8 to 16 weeks. Timelines are confirmed in writing after a discovery call.

## Areas served
Based in Chennai, India. Works remotely with businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand and India (every state and union territory), plus Europe (including the Czech Republic), the Middle East and Asia. Zudo Works is an independent Zoho development team, not yet an approved Zoho Partner.
